## Triage: **p2** · `bug` · lane **`domain:ui`** · `area:records` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-20T01:53Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Fresh read on objectui `origin/main` `df943a2a1a`.

**Premise holds.** `plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx:488–505` reads `referenceVia` to draw the id half as the labelled record card. The type half (`object_name`) is still a visible field outside the strip and the H1, so `record:details` draws it again as its own row of stored API name.

**Why p2.** It is user-visible on every record page of a pointer-pair object (sharing, audit, approvals), and it belongs to the objectstack-ai/objectstack#24501 / #24611 family (p2).

**Route: the render rule the card names.** `record:details` folds a declared `referenceVia` type half into its id half's card and does not draw it as a row. This reads the pair the spec declares and maps no name to anything, so it is not the console-side mapping objectstack-ai/objectstack#24375 rules out. ⛔ No per-object `hidden: true` on the objectstack side. Pin as the card says, with an object without a pair as the control.

`finding` comes off.

ACCEPT — PR #13109 @ `5a5fd3415eb40ce01d89c3797bdf3899f94604dd` · `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`)

- Clause-②: no. `foldPointerTypeHalves` is module-private in `record-details.tsx`; no export, prop or key moves. No contract review is owed, and the seat read the diff.
- Seat review:
  - A declared pair is a field whose non-empty `referenceVia` names a declared sibling. No field name is read.
  - The type half is dropped from the direct fields list and from every section only when its id half is drawn in the same body. `ctx.data` is untouched, so the card still resolves the pair.
  - An object with no pair returns its body unchanged.
  - The refinement (no id half drawn → the type half keeps its row, because nothing else names the target) is right, and it is pinned.
- Pins: sections and direct-fields bodies with a pair (one card, no type-half row); id half not drawn (the row kept); a CONTROL with the same names but no `referenceVia`. The ablation turned both pair cases red with the controls green, and the restore was proven by blob.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `patch`.
- CI: all 36 check-runs completed on the head, 33 passed and 3 skipped.
- Path fork: no governed path, 268 changed lines. Seat landing.
- Dev open question (Lock vs Gates clause): A. Declare the full package dir to CI, as on every dispatch this round.
- Findings: Acceptance notes. `record:highlights` (the strip) does not draw a `referenceVia` id half through the pointer card, so a pair split across the strip and the body would show `record_id` as raw text in the strip. This is a source reading with no reproduction, and no shipped object is known to split a pair there.

Next: ready + auto-merge; landing is verified by content on `main`.
